recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Shared types & value objects
recommended_phases.rationale: Foundation all modules import. Pure data shapes with no owned logic.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Employee, Policy, Balance, Audit modules
recommended_phases.rationale: Leaf modules with no cross-module deps (only shared-types). Build before leave which orchestrates them.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Notification module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared-types; can be built alongside or after leaves.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — Leave module (orchestrator) + routes/controller
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all leaf modules; wires apply/approve/reject flows, RBAC guards, audit, notifications.

app_notes: Application layer for the leave management module. Layer boundaries: presentation (routes/controllers) → application (services) → domain (entities) → infrastructure (repositories). Dependencies flow inward only; leave is the sole orchestrator and depends on balance, policy, employee, notification, and audit — none of those depend back on leave, so no cycles. All cross-module pure value types (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, DTOs, FiscalYear) live in src/shared/types/; entities with owned behavior (LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, Employee, LeavePolicy, AuditRecord) each own their module directory. Every public service method is declared in an interface before implementation. Repositories are declared per-module (ILeaveRepository, IBalanceRepository, IEmployeeRepository, IPolicyRepository, IAuditRepository) to satisfy GP-001.

open_questions.question: How are leave days counted for a request spanning partial days or weekends/holidays?
open_questions.impact: Affects balance deduction amount and policy validation; must be consistent across applyForLeave, validateRequest, and deductBalance.

open_questions.question: How is the fiscal year derived for a leave request?
open_questions.impact: Determines which balance bucket and policy apply; must be consistent across balance and policy lookups.
candidate_options: Fiscal year of the request creation date

open_questions.question: What is the rounding rule for partial-day balances (e.g. half-day leave)?
open_questions.impact: Affects balance arithmetic and policy max-day checks; must be uniform across deduct/credit/validate.

auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: UserRole }; UserRole = 'employee' | 'manager' | 'hr_admin'. Identity obtained via JWT bearer verified by an auth middleware that populates request.user. RBAC enforced by a requireRole(...) route-level guard, never inline: applyForLeave → employee; approveLeave/rejectLeave → manager (or hr_admin); balance/policy reads → employee (own) or manager/hr_admin.
error_response_contract: Errors return { error: string; code: string }. Validation failure → HTTP 400; authentication failure → 401; authorization failure → 403; not found (request/employee/policy) → 404; insufficient balance / policy violation → 422.
